acq_time.Description: Acquisition time of the particular scan

duration.Description: Wallclock duration of the scan, in seconds, from the onset of the first to the end of the last acquired volume or sample. Estimated from the DICOM headers (see heudiconv.dicoms.get_acquisition_duration) or, retrospectively, from the NIfTI/JSON sidecar. See also https://github.com/bids-standard/bids-specification/pull/2508

reprostim_path.Description: Path to the source .mkv file the injected recording was sliced from, relative to the videos.tsv location

reprostim_offset.Description: Offset of the buffer-segment start into the source video

reprostim_buffer_before.Description: Actual buffer prepended before scan onset

reprostim_buffer_after.Description: Actual buffer appended after scan end

qr_count.Description: Number of unique QR code records found in the injected recording

qr_first_trigger_offset.LongName: Offset of the first QR trigger event in seconds
qr_first_trigger_offset.Description: Time from the start of the injected recording to the QR code carrying the first 'trigger' event

qr_first_trigger_abstime.LongName: Clock time of the first QR trigger event
qr_first_trigger_abstime.Description: Clock time of day (no date), as parsed from the QR code, when the first 'trigger' event was received

reprostim_isotime_full.Description: ISO 8601 time of the original video file the injected recording was cut from

reprostim_isotime_offset.LongName: ReproStim offset since source video start in seconds
reprostim_isotime_offset.Description: Number of seconds since the start of the original video file at which the injected recording was cut

video_duration.Description: Duration of the injected video recording

video_framecount.Description: Number of frames in the injected video recording
